Industry/name for symbols that are DELISTED, hence absent from dash_slim.bin's currently-listed universe -- which is the only source build_sf_data.py has for meta.ind, so every one of them came out ind='Unknown', name=<symbol>. That is not a classification gap, it is a survivorship gap: the scrape only covers live scrips. 2,008 of the live bin's 4,445 symbols are affected; the 26 here are the ones that reached Nifty 500 membership between 2020-01 and 2026-06 and so showed up as holes on the coverage matrix (industry 857 cells).
SOURCE: BSE ComHeadernew/w -> IndustryNew, the SAME field fetch_sectors.py reads for live scrips, so the vocabulary is identical by construction and needs no cross-map (verified: RELIANCE 500325 returns 'Oil, Gas & Consumable Fuels', which is exactly what dash_slim stores).
IDENTITY GATE: the BSE code came from Moneycontrol's autosuggest and was accepted only when the ISIN matched ours -- exactly, or on the 7-char issuer prefix where a face-value change reissued it (runbook §95). Then BSE's OWN returned ISIN had to confirm it again. A name match was never enough: MC's top hit for HDFC is HDFC *Bank* and for HEXAWARE is HEXT, both different securities.
Consumed by build_sf_data.py when the live universe has no row for a symbol.
2026-08-16 (N500 2015-2019 campaign, PLAN_N500_COVERAGE_2015_2020.md): +43 entries for the delisted members that showed as industry holes on the 2015-01..2019-12 window (2,111 cells over 89 names). Route reach MEASURED, not assumed: of 81 names resolvable by exact ISIN in BSE's all-status scrip master, ComHeadernew returned a non-empty IndustryNew for only 37 -- the other 44 (older full delistings: the merged PSU banks, RANBAXY, CAIRN, GRUH, SBBJ/SBT, CMC, POLARIS ...) return an EMPTY classification block from BSE. Those are recorded not-found-via:bse-comheadernew and stay visible gaps; they need an aggregator rung of the §57 ladder, never a guess. 7 further names carry a REISSUED ISIN (IBC/face-value/rename): matched on the 9-char issuer+type prefix, confirmed by BSE's own returned ISIN on the successor, and each checked for same-business continuity against our own series spans. TUBEINVEST is deliberately WITHHELD: its series ends 2017-08-23 (pre-demerger Tube Investments of India, a manufacturer) while its ISIN successor is Cholamandalam Financial Holdings (Financial Services) and the manufacturing business went to a SEPARATE listing, TIINDIA -- filling it from the successor would misclassify the historical series and corrupt indRank for the era. Needs adjudication, not an inference.
